name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 12 months' continuous residence immediately preceding the application, plus at least 7 years' total residence within the preceding 10 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 12 months' immediate residence and 7 of the preceding 10 years in Tanzania.

requirements.blocker_text: Adequate knowledge of Kiswahili or English.
Naturalization is barred unless the applicant renounces any other nationality beforehand (Section 7(5)) -- Tanzania does not permit dual citizenship.
requirements.fix_path: Renounce prior nationality before or as part of the naturalization process.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 12 months' immediate + 7/10 years' residence
Newspaper notice of naturalization intent (2 consecutive issues)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 12 months immediately preceding application, plus 7 of the preceding 10 years

sources.title: Embassy of Tanzania, Washington D.C. -- general naturalization requirements: 12 months immediate + 7 of preceding 10 years' residence, Kiswahili/English proficiency, good character, demonstrated contribution, newspaper notice, district/regional security-committee interviews, USD 1,500 fee, and Section 7(5)'s bar on naturalization without prior renunciation of other nationality

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Tanzania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct official-embassy sourcing, tier 1. DISTINCTIVE PROCEDURAL FINDINGS: applicants must publish notice of their naturalization intent in two consecutive issues of a registered Tanzanian newspaper, AND undergo interviews with defense and security committees at both district and regional levels -- a heavier vetting apparatus than most other naturalization routes in this dataset. The USD 1,500 non-refundable fee is also high relative to comparable routes built elsewhere in this dataset. dual_citizenship_allowed set false per Section 7/7(5) -- Tanzania requires renunciation of other nationalities both to retain citizenship acquired otherwise and as a precondition for naturalization itself.
